$comment:
correspondence.json (task A6; plans/01-architecture.md §3, 'the heart'). Top-level value is an ARRAY of entries, keyed by cemTag — Figma component keys are explicitly NOT here (they live in profiles/

/keys..json, evidence #5: node-ids anchor within a kit version, keys are a per-fileKey cache). Validated with the hand-rolled checker in src/lib/validate.mjs (no oneOf/$ref/conditionals), so this ONE schema admits both entry shapes the matcher produces rather than a discriminated union: (1) the default 'component' shape (figmaSets/axes/props) covering the matcher's fusion/set/standalone/code-only kinds — see matcherKind — and (2) the iconTable shape (kind:'iconTable', icons[]) for the one m3e-icon value-table entry (D7). A single entry never carries both figmaSets/axes/props AND icons in practice, but the flat validator can't enforce that mutual exclusion — merge.mjs is the source of truth for which fields a given entry actually gets.

cemTag.$comment: The CEM tag — the entry's primary key (architecture §3 item 6: identity anchors on node-id/tag within a pinned kit version, never on Figma's mutable component key).

kind.$comment: Discriminator for the icon value-table shape ONLY (brief's verbatim iconTable admission). Absent on every other entry — the default 'component' shape needs no discriminator since figmaSets is already an array (0, 1, or N sets uniformly cover code-only/standalone/set/set-fusion).

matcherKind.$comment: RECONCILIATION: the brief's kind enum (set-fusion/standalone/code-only/iconTable) doesn't match src/match/matcher.mjs's actual candidate.kind values (fusion/set/standalone/icon/code-only — see task-A6-report.md). This field preserves the matcher's real kind for traceability/debugging without overloading the schema's own 'kind' discriminator (reserved for iconTable). Not present on iconTable entries (their origin, kind:'icon' in the matcher, is implied). 'manual' is the value for entries injected via manual-correspondence.json (the matcher structurally cannot reach those Figma sets).

figmaSets.$comment: 0 sets (code-only: a CEM tag with no Figma counterpart at all), 1 set (standalone/set kinds), or N sets (set-fusion — one fixed attr value per sibling set, architecture §3 item 1).

nodeId.$comment: Stable anchor within a pinned kit version (evidence #5) — never a Figma component key.

fixedAttrs.$comment: The fixed CEM attr=value this set contributes to the fusion (e.g. {"variant":"tonal"}); {} for a non-fused set/standalone.

slugSuffix.$comment: appendSets mechanism (T1/T2): when present, REPLACES the fixedAttrs-derived slug segment in the emitted filename/id. Stored only on appended sets injected via manual-correspondence appendSets.

example.$comment: Inline per-set example content (shape mirrors examples.json entries — a 'children' array of child descriptors). Takes precedence over any cemTag-level examples.json entry for this set. Two origins: the appendSets mechanism (T1/T2, a newly-appended set), or manual-correspondence.json's setExamples mechanism (Phase 3.1, plans/2026-08-17-figma-elm-config-integration-design.md) — a content-only overlay onto a set the entry ALREADY has (any origin, incl. a real auto match), which changes only this field and leaves matcherKind/provenance/fixedAttrs untouched.

axes.$comment: One entry per Figma VARIANT axis: mapped ({figmaProp,attr,valueMap}) or unmapped ({figmaProp,unmapped}) — Figma-only axes (Width/State) are never silently dropped (architecture §3 item 4).

kind.$comment: Present only on a BOOLEAN axis (kind:"boolean", RC1): a 2-option boolean-shaped Figma axis bound to a boolean CEM attr. Enum axes omit this. Signals drive.mjs to apply HTML boolean-attribute presence (present=on / absent=off), never the literal string "true"/"false".

additionalProperties.$comment: null means 'omit this attribute for this Figma value' — the component renders at its own default (e.g. fab Size=Default has no size attr).

valueMap.$comment: Figma option -> CEM value. Enum axis: {"XSmall":"extra-small"}. Boolean axis (kind:"boolean"): the two options -> "true"/"false", which drive.mjs reads as presence, not a literal attr value. null value means 'omit the attribute' (component default).

attrs.$comment: MULTI-ATTR axis: when one Figma axis drives MULTIPLE CEM boolean attrs (e.g. checkbox Type→{checked,indeterminate}). Each item is {attr, valueMap} where valueMap values are "true"/"false" (boolean presence). Mutually exclusive with the single-attr `attr`+`valueMap` shape; kind:"multi-boolean" is always set on these axes.

unmapped.$comment: Reason there is no CEM counterpart for this axis.

props.$comment: One entry per non-variant Figma property (TEXT/BOOLEAN/INSTANCE_SWAP): mapped ({figmaProp,kind,binding}) or unmapped ({figmaProp,kind,unmapped}).

kind.$comment: text | boolean | instanceSwap (lowerCamel of the Figma property TYPE).

unmapped.$comment: Reason there is no CEM counterpart for this property.

visibilityAxis.$comment: RC2 chip Configuration→slot-visibility: the Figma VARIANT axis name that controls whether this prop's slot is shown. When present, the slot is only injected if the axis's current value (driven or default) is in visibleWhen[].

visibleWhen.$comment: The set of Figma axis values (for visibilityAxis) that make this prop visible. If the current axis value is not in this list, the slot is omitted.

iconName.$comment: RC5 literalIcon: the Material Symbols ligature name of the FIXED icon to emit when this boolean prop is true. Used with kind:"literalIcon" only — the icon name is not instance-swappable; it is hardcoded in the correspondence entry (e.g. search-bar's Show leading icon → search).

slotTag.$comment: RC5 text-to-slot: the HTML element tag name to use as the slot child when a kind:"text" prop binds to a named slot (binding:"slot:<name>"). Encodes as "<slotTag>:<text>" in the harness URL (e.g. slotTag:"input" → slot.input=input:Hinted search text → <input slot="input" placeholder="Hinted search text">). Absent for default-slot text (binding:"content") or attr bindings.

icons.$comment: iconTable entries only — one row per Material Symbols icon (D7 + evidence #12): NOT 141 separate correspondence entries.

filled.$comment: Material Symbols FILL axis. Derived from the Figma name's '_filled' suffix (the ligature name in symbolName has it stripped). m3e-icon renders it via the `filled` attribute.

provenance.$comment: RECONCILIATION: the brief's enum is auto-exact|auto-fuzzy|human. 'auto-gap' is added for matcherKind:'code-only' entries (a CEM tag the matcher could not bind to ANY Figma candidate at exact/fuzzy tier, tier:'gap' in matcher output) — the brief itself requires these entries be admitted ('accommodate ... code-only kinds too, don't lose them'), and forcing them into auto-exact/auto-fuzzy would misrepresent a match that never happened. See task-A6-report.md. 'manual' is added for entries injected via manual-correspondence.json (the matcher structurally cannot reach those Figma sets — local injection only affects the named cemTags).

rationale.$comment: Auditable human-readable string, joined from the matcher's rationale[] (+ fusion.rationale when present). Human review happens at this component+property level, never per-variant (architecture §3 item 5, §3.5).

proposedUpdate.$comment: Present only when a re-run's fresh auto-proposal differs from a HUMAN-protected entry (provenance:'human' OR status:'confirmed'). The protected entry itself is never modified; the new auto data lands here for review instead. Shape mirrors this same entry schema (not re-validated recursively by the hand-rolled checker, but produced by the same code path that produces every other entry).
